Noreen Irena Ghartey

About Me

I am a trained medical doctor from Ghana, now residing in Columbia, MD. Currently I am a full-time graduate student at Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. I am interested in research that sits at the intersection of digital health and pediatrics. I have used stata in the past and have learned python but I never really worked with them so all of this feels very new to me. I hope to gain confidence in using R by the end of this course.

Fun Facts

I love talking about horror movies, and I play multiple sports for fun esp tennis and volleyball. I love arts and cooking.

Cool Stuff

I used to vlog and share on my youtube channel. Although it’s been 4 years since I put anything on there, watching those videos back is so refreshing and often helps me deal with mental stress.
